title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses Rs 380 Crore in India, Becomes Highest-Grossing Film of 2026
excerpt: The Marvel blockbuster surpassed Rs 300 crore in just six days, becoming only the third Hollywood film to achieve the feat in India.
body:
• Spider-Man: Brand New Day crossed Rs 380 crore gross at the Indian box office within its first week
  • The film became only the third Hollywood movie to surpass Rs 300 crore net in India, after Avatar: The Way of Water and Avengers: Endgame
  • Its opening day collection of Rs 60.60 crore net set a new record for non-Indian films in India
  • Globally, the film has earned $1.155 billion in seven days, surpassing Toy Story 5 as the highest-grossing film of 2026

Spider-Man: Brand New Day has crossed the Rs 380 crore gross mark at the Indian box office within just seven days, cementing its position as the biggest Hollywood release of the year in India and one of the most successful international films ever released in the country.

Record-Breaking Run

The Marvel blockbuster, starring Tom Holland and Zendaya, opened to Rs 60.60 crore net on its first day, July 30, setting a new record for non-Indian films in India. It surpassed the previous record held by Avengers: Endgame, which had earned Rs 54 crore on its opening day, according to trade data from Sacnilk.com.

The film's weekend performance was even more staggering. By day four, it had amassed Rs 207.95 crore net and Rs 313.24 crore gross, making it the first Hollywood film ever to register a Rs 300 crore opening weekend in India.

Day-by-Day Performance

According to Bollywood Hungama, the film's day-wise India net collections through its first week were: Day 1 (Rs 60.60 crore), Day 2 (Rs 49.35 crore), Day 3 (Rs 70.25 crore), Day 4 (Rs 77.75 crore, the highest single-day collection), Day 5 (Rs 23.80 crore), Day 6 (Rs 21.50 crore), and Day 7 (Rs 15.20 crore). The film's current lifetime collection stands at approximately Rs 305.11 crore net.

The English original version led collections, with the Hindi dubbed version emerging as the strongest performing dubbed language. On day three alone, the Hindi version earned Rs 21.75 crore across 7,311 shows with 97 percent occupancy, indicating packed theatres across northern India.

India's Hollywood Top 10

With Rs 305.11 crore net, Brand New Day has climbed to third place among the highest-grossing Hollywood releases in India, trailing only Avatar: The Way of Water (Rs 378.22 crore) and Avengers: Endgame (Rs 373.22 crore). It has comfortably surpassed Avengers: Infinity War (Rs 227.43 crore) and Spider-Man: No Way Home (Rs 218.41 crore).

Global Dominance

Globally, the film has earned an estimated $1.155 billion after just seven days in cinemas, according to Variety. North America contributed $449 million, while international markets generated $706.3 million. The film has overtaken Toy Story 5, which grossed $1.067 billion since its June release, to become the highest-grossing film of 2026 worldwide.

Avengers: Endgame directors Anthony and Joe Russo congratulated the Brand New Day team, writing on Instagram: "The gauntlet has been passed."

What's Next

With another weekend approaching, the film is expected to cross the Rs 400 crore gross milestone in India, potentially challenging Avatar: The Way of Water for the all-time Hollywood record. Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, the film follows Peter Parker dealing with the aftermath of people forgetting his existence.
